validation_note: Official/public institutional sources only; analogies are lessons, not diagnoses.

cases.name: Pyramid Lake / Truckee River
cases.observed_pattern: USFWS documents irrigation diversion, reduced Truckee River levels and blocked spawning access, followed by fish-passage restoration.
cases.management_lesson: Track both flow volume and physical connectivity across barriers.

provenance.title: Back after More than a Century
provenance.supports: Derby Dam diverted water, reduced river levels and blocked spawning habitat connected to Pyramid Lake.

cases.name: Lake Rotorua
cases.observed_pattern: Regional rules limit nitrogen entering the lake while the restoration programme also uses wastewater upgrades and wetlands.
cases.management_lesson: Quantify nutrient sources and combine regulation, treatment and nature-based filtration.

provenance.title: Lake Rotorua Nutrient Management - Plan Change 10
provenance.supports: Rules limit nitrogen entering Lake Rotorua from land use as part of an integrated programme.

cases.name: Vembanad Lake / Thanneermukkom Barrage
cases.observed_pattern: Kerala describes the barrage across Vembanad as salinity-control infrastructure, with modernization aimed at minimizing ecological decay.
cases.management_lesson: Evaluate exchange, residence time and ecology on both sides of a control structure.

provenance.title: Thanneermukkom
provenance.supports: The barrage prevents saline intrusion and its modernization targets salinity management and ecological decay.

cases.name: Lake Geneva (Léman)
cases.observed_pattern: CIPEL reports phosphorus decline since the 1980s from source-control policy while blooms and climate-driven hydrology remain concerns.
cases.management_lesson: Continue hydrology and ecosystem monitoring after successful nutrient reduction.

provenance.title: Scientific actions — Action Plan 2021-2030
provenance.supports: Phosphorus fell after domestic and non-point source controls; bloom and hydrology monitoring continues under climate change.

cases.name: Lake Constance (Bodensee)
cases.observed_pattern: IGKB documents a late-1970s phosphorus peak followed by a large decline after wastewater treatment and phosphorus removal, with biological recovery.
cases.management_lesson: Measure the chain from source-load reduction to lake chemistry and biology.

provenance.title: Phosphor im Bodensee
provenance.supports: Wastewater treatment and phosphorus precipitation reduced lake phosphorus from the eutrophic peak toward oligotrophic levels.

cases.name: Lake Balaton
cases.observed_pattern: The European Commission highlights a record 2019 bloom and research linking warming with nutrient release from sediments.
cases.management_lesson: Track internal sediment nutrients after external loads are reduced.

provenance.title: Climate warming may increase algal blooms caused by sediment nutrient release in lakes
provenance.supports: Lake Balaton's 2019 bloom is used to show warming-related internal nutrient release and prior eutrophication pressure.

cases.name: Lake Taihu
cases.observed_pattern: China's environment ministry describes long-term Taihu work addressing point, non-point and internal pollution with ecological rehabilitation and algae-removal technology.
cases.management_lesson: Classify pollution pathways before choosing interventions.

provenance.publisher: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China
provenance.title: Water Body Pollution Control Program in Jiangsu Province
provenance.supports: Taihu control targets point-source, non-point and endogenous pollution and uses ecological rehabilitation and algae removal.

cases.name: Qiandao Lake / Xin'an River Basin
cases.observed_pattern: World Bank documents catchment pollution pressure and integrated watershed management using climate-smart farming, forest management and wetland restoration.
cases.management_lesson: Treat the lake as the receiving end of the entire landscape and tributary network.

provenance.title: World Bank to Help Three Chinese Provinces Improve Water Resources Management
provenance.supports: Qiandao Lake faces agricultural and domestic catchment pollution; integrated watershed management is the project response.

cases.name: Lake Rotoroa (Hamilton)
cases.observed_pattern: Waikato Regional Council reports macrophyte die-off released nutrients and reduced clarity; later plant recovery absorbed nutrients and stabilized sediments.
cases.management_lesson: Track vegetation cover, nutrient release and sediment resuspension together in shallow lakes.

provenance.title: Lake Rotoroa
provenance.supports: Macrophyte die-off degraded water quality; vegetation recovery absorbed nutrients and helped stabilize sediments.

cases.name: Hai Basin / Bohai receiving system
cases.observed_pattern: World Bank documents groundwater over-exploitation, surface-water overuse and pollution, then reports reduced groundwater exploitation using integrated management and ET planning.
cases.management_lesson: Count consumptive use and evapotranspiration, not only withdrawals, when testing whether water savings reach ecosystems.

provenance.title: China: Improving Water Resource Management & Pollution Control in the Hai Basin
provenance.supports: Groundwater over-exploitation, surface-water overuse and pollution damaged the basin; ET-based management reduced groundwater exploitation.
